# Everything about Daily Operations / Daily Ops

![All about Daily Operations / Daily Ops](/uploads/8_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Note:** Recently added rewards are marked in bold.

Daily Operations are a new feature from Patch 22, which we have already reported on here at Nuka Knights. These operations are not an event and can be activated **via the map view**. There you don't need to travel to a location, just activate the daily operations on the left and join. Before you do that, here is some information and tips.

Daily operations work best as a **team**. Not because of the opponents, but because the connection points are secured more quickly. **There is a multiplier per player**, for 4 players there is a 4x multiplier for the time in which the position is safe. The best way to do this is to choose a public team with the **target “daily operations”**. There you will receive more XP when you complete one. (Tip: For all other teams outside of events, Casual is now the best choice for a team.)

## “DECRYPTION” MODE

In **Decryption Mode** you have to deactivate three radio interceptors for Vernon Dodge. To do this, you hunt down three enemy code carriers and kill them in order to get special codes that can be used to deactivate the radio interceptors. With each code carrier defeated, the waves of enemies become deadlier. The perception of enemies is not increased, so you can now use your stealth skills, but the enemies are even more dangerous since the standard mutation "Wild Strike" has an armor penetration of 99%.

## CONNECTING DEVICE MODE

In Connection Device mode, all you have to do is secure the connection points (i.e. stand close to them) to achieve the operation objectives. It doesn't matter how many enemies you kill. Only the final bosses must be killed to complete the operation.

You should also be prepared to be **always “discovered”**. So if you have a sneaking sniper or melee fighter, you won't be able to use the sneaking bonus here. The **Legendary Perk “Full Commitment”** makes a lot of sense for all builds here.

Every day at **6 p.m.** the mode, location, enemies and enemy mutations change randomly, forming a new daily operation.

## POSSIBLE LOCATIONS ARE:

- The caves
- The burning mine
-Valley Galleria
- Vault 94
- Vault 96
- West Tek Research Center
- Watoga Raider Arena
- Arktos Pharma Biome Labs
- Watoga High School
-Uncanny Caverns
- Charleston Capitol Building
- Garrahan Mining Headquarters
-Morgantown High School
- Foundry (The PITT)
- Aquarium of the Atlantic (Atlantic City)

## POSSIBLE OPPONENT FACTIONS:

- Super mutants
- Blood Eagle
- Robot (problem solver armor makes sense here)
- Burnt
- Mothman cultists
- Miner
- Communists
- Aliens
- Fanatic
- Overgrown

## STANDARD MUTATIONS:

- (Connection Device) Deadly Gaze: Enemies notice players significantly better.
- (Decryption) Savage Strike: 99% armor penetration, no improved perception

## THE OPPONENTS CONTINUE TO HAVE ONE OF THESE MUTATIONS:

- **Explosive**: Enemies explode when they die.
- **Active Camouflage**: Enemies are cloaked when not attacking.
- **Toughened**: Enemies can only be killed by a melee attack. (Here you can work with melee weapons or simply hit with the butt.
- **Icy Touch**: Enemy attacks freeze players.
- **Toxic Blood (Toxic)**: Enemies leave behind a cloud of poison when they die
- **Group Regeneration** (Regenerating): Enemies emit an aura that heals other enemies in the area.
- **Swift**: Enemies have increased movement speed
